8750.headline: Mid Ice Crisis blank Puckaneers 3-0
paragraphs: Thu Sep 17, at home at Rink 1: Mid Ice Crisis blank Puckaneers 3-0. That puts the season at 1-0.

Matthew Killeen opened the scoring at 10:05 of the second on the power play, from John Shortreed and Dylan Tadros (1-0). Christopher Mayor made it 2-0 at 1:47 of the second on the power play, from Alex Albano. ✎ Ryan Smith made it 3-0 at 2:44 of the third, from Kevin Zimmerman.

Scoring for Mid Ice Crisis: Christopher Mayor (1G), Matthew Killeen (1G) and Ryan Smith (1G). Game-winner: Matthew Killeen at 10:05 of the second. 6 PIM for Mid Ice Crisis (3 minors: High-Sticking, Roughing).

8786.headline: Mid Ice Crisis beat Fire Truck Club D 5-3
paragraphs: Sat Sep 26, at home at Rink 1: Mid Ice Crisis beat Fire Truck Club D 5-3. Mid Ice Crisis trailed by 1 at 12:26 of the first and came back. That puts the season at 2-0. That's 2 wins in a row.

Michael Tasis (Fire Truck Club D) opened the scoring at 12:26 of the first, from Avi Azouz (0-1). Derek Dettman tied it at 6:46 of the first, from Alex Albano (1-1). Justin Jennings put Mid Ice Crisis ahead at 10:50 of the second on the power play (2-1). Ryan Smith made it 3-1 at 8:22 of the second, from Christopher Mayor. Robert Cassaras (Fire Truck Club D) cut it to 3-2 at 5:19 of the second. John Shortreed made it 4-2 at 10:12 of the third. Christopher Mayor made it 5-2 at 6:49 of the third, from Dylan Tadros. ✎ Robert Cassaras (Fire Truck Club D) cut it to 5-3 at 1:08 of the third.

Scoring for Mid Ice Crisis: Christopher Mayor (1G 1A), Derek Dettman (1G) and John Shortreed (1G). Game-winner: John Shortreed at 10:12 of the third. 6 PIM for Mid Ice Crisis (3 minors: Hooking, Roughing).

Carvey Iannuzzi made it 8-0 at 4:31 of the third.

9632.headline: PB Hooker$ D roll past Puckaneers 6-2
paragraphs: Sun Sep 27, on the road at Rink 1: PB Hooker$ D roll past Puckaneers 6-2. That puts the season at 2-0. That's 2 wins in a row.

Jeremiah Cannon opened the scoring at 10:59 of the first (1-0). Louis Schulze made it 2-0 at 6:04 of the first, from Andrew Kulnick. Derek Lade (Puckaneers) cut it to 2-1 at 1:19 of the first, from Zach Puckett. Jeremiah Cannon made it 3-1 at 10:02 of the second, from Louis Schulze. Derek Lade (Puckaneers) cut it to 3-2 at 3:45 of the second on the power play. Vladimir Shtutman made it 4-2 at 1:32 of the second. Jeremiah Cannon made it 5-2 with 37.4 seconds left in the third, from Jason Sager and Dan Altman. Dan Altman made it 6-2 with 00.0 seconds left in the third.

Scoring for PB Hooker$ D: Jeremiah Cannon (3G), Dan Altman (1G 1A) and Louis Schulze (1G 1A). Game-winner: Jeremiah Cannon at 10:02 of the second. 12 PIM for PB Hooker$ D (2 minors: Tripping, Unsportsmanlike).

paragraphs: Sun Sep 20, on the road at Rink 1: Broward Barracudas blank Night Raiders 8-0. That puts the season at 1-0.

Matt Goode made it 3-0 at 8:54 of the second shorthanded. Anthony Sebanc made it 4-0 at 5:25 of the second, from Naysha Ramos. Alex Lam made it 5-0 at 4:38 of the second on the power play. Scoring for Broward Barracudas: Alex Lam (2G), Anthony Sebanc (1G 1A) and Naysha Ramos (2A). Game-winner: Gage Dumas at 3:44 of the first. 2 PIM for Broward Barracudas (1 minor: Tripping).
